From among those countries, determine the five countries with the greatest number of main commercial airports in 2022. Of those five countries, determine which countries did not increase the number of main commercial airports from 2021 to 2022. Then, of those countries, determine which countries did not have more then nine small commercial airports in 2022. Use the Eurostat website to determine all of this information.
